tools.name: BrowseAppAssets
tools.title: Browse App Assets
tools.description: List the files and directories from a relative filePath input from within the projects assets folder

project.title: project
project.description: The unique id for the project/app

filePath.title: filePath
filePath.description: The relative file path to list contents from. This relative path should assume the prefix of '/version/assets/' and not include the prefix in the string value.

tools.name: CopyAppAsset
tools.title: Copy App Asset
tools.description: Copy (clone) a file or directory in the project/app assets folder to a new path

project.title: project
project.description: The unique id for the project/app

filePath.title: filePath
filePath.description: The source file or directory to copy. This relative path should assume the prefix of '/version/assets/' and not include the prefix in the string value.

newValue.title: newValue
newValue.description: The destination path for the copy. This cannot be an existing file or directory unless override is true and has the same character restrictions you would expect on a typical file system.

override.title: override
override.description: Whether to delete an existing file or directory at the destination before copying. Defaults to false.

comment.title: comment
comment.description: Comment to add while saving the files within the git repository for the project

tools.name: CopyAppAssetsToInsight
tools.title: Copy App Assets To Insight
tools.description: Copy a single or multiple files from the projects assets folder to the current insight

project.title: project
project.description: The unique id for the project/app

filePath.title: filePath
filePath.description: Names of the file(s) to copy. This relative path should assume the prefix of '/version/assets/' and not include the prefix in the string value.

tools.name: DeleteAppAssets
tools.title: Delete App Assets
tools.description: Delete a single or multiple files in the projects assets folder

project.title: project
project.description: The unique id for the project/app

filePath.title: filePath
filePath.description: Names of the file(s) to delete. This relative path should assume the prefix of '/version/assets/' and not include the prefix in the string value. If no value is passed, all files in '/version/assets/' will be deleted.

comment.title: comment
comment.description: Comment to add while removing the files within the git repository for the project

project.title: project
project.description: The unique id for the project/app

filePath.title: filePath

tools.name: RenameAppAsset
tools.title: Rename App Asset
tools.description: Rename a file or directory in the projects assets folder

project.title: project
project.description: The unique id for the project/app

filePath.title: filePath
filePath.description: Names of the file(s) to save. This relative path should assume the prefix of '/version/assets/' and not include the prefix in the string value.

newValue.title: newValue

comment.title: comment

tools.name: SaveAppAssetsBase64
tools.title: Save App Assets Base64
tools.description: Save a single or multiple files in the projects assets folder. Content for each file is provided as base64 utf-8 encoded input.

project.title: project
project.description: The unique id for the project/app

filePath.title: filePath
filePath.description: Names of the file(s) to save. This relative path should assume the prefix of '/version/assets/' and not include the prefix in the string value.

content.title: content
content.description: Contents of the file(s) to save. Content is base64 utf-8 string.

comment.title: comment
comment.description: Comment to add while saving the files within the git repository for the project

decode.title: decode
decode.description: Boolean to decode the base64 utf-8 content string before writing to the file. Default is true

tools.name: SaveAppAssets
tools.title: Save App Assets
tools.description: Saves one or more files to the project's assets folder and commits them to the project's git repository.

project.title: project
project.description: The unique id for the project/app

filePath.title: filePath
filePath.description: Names of the file(s) to save. This relative path should assume the prefix of '/version/assets/' and not include the prefix in the string value.

content.title: content
content.description: Contents of the file(s) to save.

comment.title: comment
comment.description: Comment to add while saving the files within the git repository for the project

tools.name: SearchAppAssets
tools.title: Search App Assets
tools.description: Recursively search files and directories within the project's assets folder, filtered by search term and optional searching flags.

project.title: project
project.description: The unique id for the project/app

filePath.title: filePath
filePath.description: The relative file path to search files from. This relative path should assume the file path till project's app_root folder and relative path should start onwards

search.title: search
search.description: The search term used to filter file and directory names

options.title: options
options.description: A list of zero or more search flags to modify matching behavior. Valid values are 'case' for case-sensitive matching, 'word' for whole-word matching, and 'regex' to treat the search term as a Java regular expression. If omitted, the search is case-insensitive.

tools.name: UnzipAppAssetFile
tools.title: Unzip App Asset File
tools.description: Unzips a zip file located in the projects assets folder and commits the extracted files to git

project.title: project
project.description: The unique id for the project/app

filePath.title: filePath
filePath.description: The relative file path of the zip file within the project's assets folder to extract
